Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the director by adopting a flawed “first-listed-director heuristic,” treating Anthony Asquith as the director of “Gently My Songs Entreat” instead of Willi Forst, who directed the 1933 Austrian-German film (Leise flehen meine Lieder). This failure to resolve the ambiguity between the original film and the British remake (“Unfinished Symphony,” 1934) led the workflow toward the wrong person’s birthplace.
